_why: Some quest pages write a prerequisite as a mission NUMBER -- 'Promathia Mission 3-2', 'Zilart Mission 17', 'Aht Urhgan Mission 48' -- rather than as the mission's name. Nothing in the install can resolve those: chronicle's mission tables are keyed by NAME and carry no number field, and the wiki numbering is not the DAT id (Zilart Mission 7 'The Chamber of Oracles' is DAT id 14; Aht Urhgan Mission 16 'Ghosts of the Past' is DAT id 15). So the number -> name mapping has to come from the wiki, and this is it. The de-numbering happens in build_index.lua's resolve_prev_name, after which build_index.lua resolves it by name exactly as it does every other prerequisite.
_used_by: tools/pipeline/emit_lua.py generates tools/lib/mission_numbers.lua from this file; tools/build_index.lua:435 loads that table and uses it in resolve_prev_name, field gates.prev. NOT validate.py -- see _why.
_verified: Two independent cross-checks landed on the same answers: 'Darkness Named' and 'Ancient Vows' were already resolving by NAME to mission/cop/358 and mission/cop/248 before this file existed, and the wiki numbering independently calls them 3-5 and 2-5. Names that do not exist in the client's own table (data/dat_names.lua) are refused downstream and read as unresolved -- a black '!', never a grey one.

promathia.6-1: For Whom the Verse is Sung

_corrected: _used_by and _why previously named tools/pipeline/validate.py, which contains zero occurrences of 'mission_numbers'. That placement was tried and reverted: stage C sees only the AUTHORED copy, while chronicle carries the same prerequisite in its own `previous` field, so the row ended up holding BOTH an unresolved numbered entry and a resolved one -- and an unresolved entry reads nil, which outranks a satisfied prerequisite, pinning the quest black forever. It was moved to resolve_prev_name, the one place chronicle's names and the authored ones meet.
